title: Mexican Pilaf Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy Mexican-inspired pilaf dish made with Spanish rice, onions, and spices. Serve as a main course or side dish.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cumin and chili powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the Spanish rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, beans, and salsa (if using). Stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pilaf mixture in a bowl and top with additional shredded cheese, beans, and salsa (if desired).
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Serve the pilaf bowl with warm tortillas on the side.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro (if desired).
